name: namava
label: Namava
_comment: Namava is a React SPA. Its whole API sits under https://www.namava.ir/api
and needs no login for anything used here:
/api/v2.0/medias/episodes/{mediaId}          one episode + its series
/api/v2.0/medias/{seriesId}/single-series    the series, with its seasons
/api/v2.0/medias/seasons/{seasonId}/episodes the episodes of one season
/api/v2.0/users/info                         the logged-in user (cookie)
GEO-BLOCK. Unlike the other three sites, namava answers only Iranian IPs.
From a German IP it still returns HTTP 200 and succeeded:true, but with an
empty result — so a failure looks exactly like 'this show has no episodes'.
That is why the catalog says "fetchVia": "iran": the hourly check on ger1
asks the relay on waybill (an Iranian VPS) to make the request for it. The
relay's address and key live in config.php, never in this file, because the
extension downloads this file. See DEPLOYMENT.md section 13.
The browser half needs no relay — you are already watching from Iran.
EPISODE NUMBERS. Two different captions, and they are not the same shape:
season list  -> episodeCaption "قسمت ۷"        (just the episode)
episode page -> episodeCaption "فصل ۴ قسمت ۷"  (season AND episode)
So the catalog can use plain "as": "int", but the browser half has to pick
the two numbers apart with "extract". Do not use the API's own "orderId"
instead: in a sample of 25 random series it disagreed with the caption once
(orderId 10 where the site shows episode 9), which is the same trap sheyda
set. The label word is not always "قسمت" either — soundtrack series count in
"قطعه" — so the episode regex takes the number at the end of the caption.
mediaDuration is in MINUTES here (54), not seconds, hence "as": "minutes".
publishDate is basic ISO 8601 ("20260419T181800013Z"), which plain PHP
strtotime() cannot read; Val::time() unpacks it.
There is no reliable way to build the series page URL: the route is
/series/{id}-{slug} and no API response carries that slug. episodeUrl is the
player URL, which is what the dashboard actually links to, so seriesUrl is
left out rather than guessed.

watch._noFallback: Every namava page keeps the title 'Namava' until React replaces it, and the SPA changes the URL before the title. A title regex here would be a lie; if the API above changes, this provider needs fixing.
